title_or_table: 2024 Gazetteer Files, congressional districts of the 119th Congress
geography: The 435 districts of the 50 states and the District of Columbia’s delegate area (436 rows); Puerto Rico and the water areas coded ZZ left out
universe_or_base: Congressional districts, for the studio’s own tile layout
qualification: District 00 is an at-large seat; DC’s area is coded 98, a delegate with no vote on the House floor. Districts redrawn for 2026 elections are not these.

district.description: district number; 00 at large; 98 for DC’s delegate

printed_source_line: Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2024 Gazetteer Files, congressional districts of the 119th Congress, 50 states and DC. Retrieved November 12, 2026.
